{"sql":"WITH weekly AS (
    SELECT
        CAST(date_trunc('week', decision_date) AS DATE) AS week_start,
        SUM(n_decisions) AS decisions,
        SUM(n_approved) AS approved,
        SUM(n_approved)::DOUBLE / NULLIF(SUM(n_decisions), 0) AS approval_rate
    FROM agg_kyc_daily
    WHERE platform ILIKE 'iOS'
      AND doc_type ILIKE '%driv%'
      AND decision_date >= DATE '2026-01-19'
      AND decision_date < DATE '2026-04-27'
    GROUP BY 1
), historical AS (
    SELECT
        AVG(approval_rate) AS prior_12wk_avg_rate,
        STDDEV_SAMP(approval_rate) AS prior_12wk_sd_rate,
        MIN(approval_rate) AS prior_12wk_min_rate,
        MAX(approval_rate) AS prior_12wk_max_rate,
        COUNT(*) AS prior_12wk_weeks
    FROM weekly
    WHERE week_start >= DATE '2026-01-19'
      AND week_start < DATE '2026-04-13'
), release AS (
    SELECT
        MAX(release_date) FILTER (WHERE release_date < DATE '2026-04-13') AS latest_ios_release_before_prior_week,
        MAX(version) FILTER (WHERE release_date < DATE '2026-04-13') AS latest_ios_version_before_prior_week,
        MAX(release_date) FILTER (WHERE release_date >= DATE '2026-04-13' AND release_date < DATE '2026-04-20') AS ios_release_during_anomaly_week,
        MAX(version) FILTER (WHERE release_date >= DATE '2026-04-13' AND release_date < DATE '2026-04-20') AS ios_version_released_during_anomaly_week
    FROM stg_app_releases
    WHERE platform ILIKE 'iOS'
)
SELECT
    MAX(decisions) FILTER (WHERE week_start = DATE '2026-04-06') AS prior_week_decisions,
    MAX(approved) FILTER (WHERE week_start = DATE '2026-04-06') AS prior_week_approved,
    MAX(approval_rate) FILTER (WHERE week_start = DATE '2026-04-06') AS prior_week_approval_rate,
    MAX(decisions) FILTER (WHERE week_start = DATE '2026-04-13') AS anomaly_week_decisions,
    MAX(approved) FILTER (WHERE week_start = DATE '2026-04-13') AS anomaly_week_approved,
    MAX(approval_rate) FILTER (WHERE week_start = DATE '2026-04-13') AS anomaly_week_approval_rate,
    h.prior_12wk_avg_rate,
    h.prior_12wk_sd_rate,
    h.prior_12wk_min_rate,
    h.prior_12wk_max_rate,
    h.prior_12wk_weeks,
    r.latest_ios_release_before_prior_week,
    r.latest_ios_version_before_prior_week,
    r.ios_release_during_anomaly_week,
    r.ios_version_released_during_anomaly_week
FROM weekly
CROSS JOIN historical h
CROSS JOIN release r
GROUP BY ALL","rationale":"Compare the two specified iOS driving-licence weeks with the preceding 12 weeks’ rates and variability, and check whether an iOS release coincided with the anomaly."}
